## Change

What problem does this solve? Describe the resulting behavior and link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

State checks performed, package/source version and exact firmware/SDK tested. Mark untested assumptions clearly. UI previews must identify synthetic fixtures separately from real router captures.

- [ ] Relevant offline tests and syntax checks pass; UI/IPKs rebuilt when affected.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic; no secrets, private addresses, raw results, backups or operational configuration are included.
- [ ] Existing configuration and history are preserved; migrations/rollback limits are documented when relevant.
- [ ] Dependencies and copied code have compatible, retained license notices.
- [ ] Documentation describes changed behavior, opt-ins and limitations without claiming untested firmware support.

For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting channel in SECURITY.md before opening a public pull request.
